title: Sonyflake (Sony's Snowflake)
summary: Sonyflake is Sony's variant of Snowflake IDs: 39-bit millisecond timestamp (epoch 2014-09-01), 8-bit sequence number, and 16-bit machine ID. The 39-bit timestamp gives ~17.4 years of range. Sonyflake is used in Sony's internal systems.

notes: 8-bit sequence number (256 IDs per millisecond per machine).
